goal: Exercise the simple-loop owner's ability to recall a synthetic family from prior conversations, including irrelevant matching material.
data: Invented conversation, temporary isolated SQLite and synthetic active owner only; no household data, Gmail, effects or live delivery.
method: Actual owner processor, native conversation search/read and subscription-backed router chooser; deterministic post-run oracle grades answer and relevant source reads separately.
limits: One development attempt; model/provider usage unknown, actor/claim simulated in-process; no Desktop, actual daemon, delivery or autonomous safety qualification. A short complete search preview may be sufficient evidence but strict source-read criterion can fail even when answer text is correct.
